gate: Against V2HO-HO0-s17 scored in the same pipeline (eval_tube_queries.py with the frozen clip weighting hann_peak_norm, frame dumps scored by tools/score_frame_conventions.py, video by the frozen linker 0.45/0.6/10/16/2 with candidate filter 8 and the frozen snap 0.3/0.75/2): (a) every-frame VOC (ROAD protocol) >= control + 1.0 on confirm g22/g23 (control 91.69) and >= control + 0.5 on tune g24/g25 (control 94.46); (b) annotated-frame VOC >= control - 0.5 on both (controls 96.37 / 95.45); (c) confirm video AP50 >= control - 2.0 (control 78.53). All three must hold.
one_variable: data.filter_empty_clips true -> false with data.empty_clip_repeats 3 (action-free training clips kept and repeated 3x); everything else is the V2HO-HO0-s17 recipe, seed 17, 30 epochs
purpose: Detections on frames outside annotated actions cost 3.67 frame mAP when every frame is scored (test 89.54 vs 93.21). Training drops fully action-free clips (3.4% of clips). This keeps them and repeats them 3x. Held-out diagnosis before launch: 88% (tune) / 72% (confirm) of detections >= 0.5 on action-free frames lie within 32 frames of an annotated frame, and removing every such detection farther than 32 frames would raise every-frame VOC by only 0.23 / 1.08, so a large gain is not expected.
test_use: V2-WS2.0E3 is evaluated on split-1 test once, under the frozen protocol, only if V2HO-E3-s17 passes its gate; it then replaces V2-WS2.0 as the reported UCF101-24 model whatever its test result. If the gate fails it is not evaluated on test.
